context: A boss mentors a uni intern on sportswriting
purpose: Teach: イチロー/ホンダ/野村/三浦/岡本/宮本/上田/松田

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、スポーツ取材、イチロー級は別格として、地道に取材力を鍛えろ。
lines.en: Ren, with sports reporting—Ichiro-class talent is rare. Build your craft through steady, unglamorous work.
lines.style: Measured, direct. Leans forward slightly on 'steadily.' The tone of someone passing on hard-won wisdom, not lecturing. Warm conviction underneath the instruction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。ホンダ系のレーシングチーム、来週インタビュー予定です。
lines.en: Yes. I have a Honda racing team interview scheduled for next week.
lines.style: Brisk, eager. Sits up straighter. Each phrase is clean and prepared—he's thought about this. Respectful but genuine, not performing deference.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 野村元監督、御縁あるから紹介できる。
lines.en: Former coach Nomura—I have a connection. I can introduce you.
lines.style: Casual confidence, almost offhand. Light tap on the offer—not calling attention to the gift being given. The ease of someone who makes these connections quietly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 三浦投手、岡本選手も、若手特集で取り上げたいです。
lines.en: Pitcher Miura, outfielder Okamoto—I want them for the youth feature.
lines.style: Rapid-fire, building energy. Specific, not vague. The brightness of ambition; he's already seeing the piece. Slight lean forward on the names.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 宮本キャプテン、上田コーチ、松田ベテラン、それぞれの視点を取れ。
lines.en: Captain Miyamoto, Coach Ueda, veteran Matsuda—get the angle from each of them.
lines.style: Calm, deliberate list. Slight pause between names—giving each weight. Teaching him to think in layers, not headlines. The voice of someone who knows these people matter.
